**P1.12 — Clarification cannot be authored, so RM-AGENT-RELIABILITY D12's gates are vacuous.** Two rules in `src/artifact/grammar.ts` are mutually exclusive (F38). The error text at the Clarifications validator *instructs* a target attribute holding an IC-*, INV-*, or AC-* token; a non-empty target attribute is required; that value must be a canonical anchor of one of those three families; and `validateSemanticAnchorDiscipline` rejects any canonical anchor in any attribute value (`artifact.semantic-anchor-attribute`). All three advertised families were probed; all three error. Zero Clarification instances exist under `.ngrace/`. The element shipped and was never exercised.
The approve-gate reader (`src/gates/core.ts`, `listClarifications`) takes `node.attributes.target` and skips an empty target. RM-AGENT-RELIABILITY D12's approve requirement `no-unresolved-ic-inv-clarification` is therefore `present=true` whenever no authorable Clarification exists. Observed on the last bundle: the approve gate printed that requirement satisfied vacuously. Apply's `no-unresolved-satisfied-ac-clarification` is the same vacancy on the AC-* half.
The existing suite does not catch this. `grammar.test.ts` plants the attribute form and asserts the codes do not include `change.invalid-clarification-target` while the document is simultaneously emitting `artifact.semantic-anchor-attribute` (F23: a negative on one code, read as "this shape is valid"). `gates/core.test.ts` plants the same illegal attribute form, never runs lint, and asserts approve refuse. That green is F28: the reader works on a document no author can write.
Teaching sites still ship the broken form: `ngrace-spec` and `ngrace-plan` SKILL.md plus each skill's `references/*.xml` template, each mirrored under `plugins/ngrace/skills/ngrace/`. Two of those are XML templates for verbatim copying, and they do not lint.
The same two codes already have exact guides. `ngrace lint --explain` classifies `change.invalid-clarification` and `change.invalid-clarification-target` as exact; both instruct a target attribute (measured at 7e8b7de: 1 and 4 rendered lines mention target). Landing the emitted- message rewrite without those guides would leave `--explain` teaching the form that cannot lint — two teaching surfaces contradicting, which is worse than one wrong surface. The `change.duplicate-clarifications-section` exact guide is not about this element's shape (0 rendered lines mention target).
**Fix direction is settled and is not reopened here:** the target becomes a self-closing anchor child, matching AffectedAreas. Do not exempt the attribute from wall §3.5 (anchors are grep-stable tags). The attribute form is **rejected**, not kept as a deprecated alias — argued in Constraints.

**P1.9 — optional context cannot be declared in DurableScope.** `NGRACE_OPTIONAL_CONTEXT_ARTIFACTS` is `design-system.xml` and `invariants.xml`, with an explicit comment that merging it into `NGRACE_CONTEXT_ARTIFACTS` would break every existing project. `DURABLE_SCOPE_DIRECT_TAGS` admits ContextArtifacts / ContextArtifact. `extractDurableScope` accepts those leaf tags only when the text is in the *required* list (`scope.invalid-context-artifact` otherwise). An OptionalContext child is `change.plan-invalid-section-shape` today. The two optional files can exist on disk and be validated when present; a plan cannot name them as durable scope. Step 9 prefers a dedicated bucket over widening ContextArtifact so required-vs-optional stays a parent distinction, not a leak in the required list.

Goals.Goal: **P1.12 authorable shape.** A Clarification whose target is exactly one self-closing IC-*, INV-*, or AC-* child lints clean. Proven once per family, not on one sample. Cardinality is closed: zero target children is an error; two or more is an error; a leftover target attribute is an error. The `resolved="true"` / `status="resolved"` attributes stay attributes — their values are not anchors.

**P1.12 gates fire.** On a document that lints clean under the new shape: an unresolved IC-* or INV-* Clarification makes `evaluateApproveGate` refuse with `gate.approve.clarification-unresolved` and `no-unresolved-ic-inv-clarification` `present=false`; the same document with `resolved="true"` permits. An unresolved AC-* that a task Satisfies makes `evaluateApplyGate` refuse with `gate.apply.clarification-unresolved`; a resolved one does not (other apply requirements held aside). The reader takes the child tag, not `attributes.target`.

**P1.9 bucket.** DurableScope admits an OptionalContext child. That bucket admits the two members of `NGRACE_OPTIONAL_CONTEXT_ARTIFACTS` and rejects required context filenames, unknown filenames, and a widened ContextArtifact list. The two constants stay separate.

**Teaching.** Both skill trees, both XML templates, and the two exact guides for this element's shape teach the child-anchor form and do not teach the attribute form. `bun run validate:marketplace` is green after the skill edit.

**Decided here, not deferred to the plan. Attribute form is rejected.** Zero Clarification instances exist, so there is no migration burden and no compatibility window to buy. A deprecated alias that still carries a canonical anchor in an attribute is not authorable unless we exempt that attribute, which is the repair F38 forbids. Therefore: one shape; the gate reader does not consult `attributes.target`; a leftover target attribute is an error even when a valid child is also present. The implication of the empty corpus is that we do not ship a dual-read, a shim, or a conversion.

**Decided here — OptionalContext shape.** OptionalContext is a DurableScope child (added to the supported-child set). It is a bucket, not a leaf: it contains the same filename-text entry tags DurableScope already uses for required context (ContextArtifact / Context / Artifact). Membership of those entries is checked against `NGRACE_OPTIONAL_CONTEXT_ARTIFACTS`, not `NGRACE_CONTEXT_ARTIFACTS`. ContextArtifact as a *direct* DurableScope child continues to accept only the required list. Do not merge the constants. Do not add the optional names to `CONTEXT_ARTIFACT_NAMES` in `scope.ts`. The extract-and-overlap consumer in `scope.ts` must see the optional names (a DurableScope that lints but is invisible to overlap is F10). How that is stored on the DurableScope object is the plan's, provided optional and required names remain distinguishable and optional-vs-optional overlap is detected.
